# Mutants for a method read only to test for it (#4q1b2er)

Each mutant is one exact line edit, run on a Linux box against the test it names, then put back from
a saved copy. The oracle rows run with `ADAMIC_GATE_UNCACHED=1`. The lower tests are in
internal/lower/method_presence_test.go, and the oracle's is internal/oracle/method_presence_test.go.

| Mutant | Edit | Red |
|---|---|---|
| Every consumer admitted | lower/method_presence.go, `methodPresenceTest`: `\|\| !l.alwaysPresentMethod(node) \|\| !presenceConsumer(node) {` made `\|\| !l.alwaysPresentMethod(node) {` | TestMethodReadsThatKeepTheValueAreRefused, all eight rows, `\|\|` among them: each stops as not yet at property's backstop instead of refused, since no consumer hook takes it. TestAMethodReadAsAValueIsRefused's six rows go red with them |
| The receiver not evaluated | `methodPresence`: `return methodPresenceRead{effects: []ir.Statement{ir.Evaluate{Value: value}}}, true, nil` made `return methodPresenceRead{}, true, nil` | TestMethodPresenceAgreesWithNode, receiver_effects.a, native, sanitized and javascript: the getter never runs for a test, so its count prints 0 where Node prints 1. The other five stay green: their receivers are reads with no effects, and optional_receiver.a's ?. test reads its receiver through its presence, not through the effects this drops |
| The receiver's construction not asked | lower/method_presence.go, `methodPresence`: `if !class && !library {` made `if false && !class && !library {`, and `if !class && value.Type() != ir.Array && value.Type() != ir.String {` made `if false && ...` | TestMethodPresenceTheReceiverDoesntProveIsNotYet, all five rows: the interface parameter, the interface condition, the cast receiver, the host value and the Map each fold to a constant. TestMethodPresenceThroughAViewIsNotYet, unproven/view_lacks_method.ts, native, sanitized and javascript: it lowers and prints "function" twice where Node prints "undefined" then "function", the silent miscompile the guard stops |
| The library pin moved off es2024 | internal/load/load.go, `compilerOptions`: `Lib: []string{"lib.es2024.d.ts"},` made `Lib: []string{"lib.es2026.d.ts"},` | TestMethodPresenceLibraryStopsAtES2024 (internal/lower/method_presence_test.go), at its precondition: no program loads, the prelude's Set declarations colliding with lib.es2025's (`Duplicate identifier 'has'`), so this whole widening is stopped before any fold. The next row reaches the rows themselves |
| A later library added beside es2024 | the same line made `Lib: []string{"lib.es2024.d.ts", "lib.es2026.math.d.ts", "lib.es2025.regexp.d.ts"},` | TestMethodPresenceLibraryStopsAtES2024's lib.es2026.math and lib.es2025.regexp rows: Math.sumPrecise and RegExp.escape load, so the library fold would say "function" for methods Node 24 may not have. The typedarrays and temporal rows stay green, their libraries untouched |
